# Draft:Personal Warehouse

Personal Warehouse is a United States real-estate development company that builds and sells small-bay, owner-occupied industrial condominium units sometimes described as micro-flex or garage-condominium spaces. The company has developed projects in Texas; in June 2025, local media reported a ribbon-cutting for a project in Dripping Springs, Texas []. A Colorado project received municipal design-award recognition in 2019 [].
History
Personal Warehouse was founded in 1999 in Colorado, according to company materials []. Early projects consisted of small-bay industrial units intended for owner-occupiers []. By the mid-2020s the company had developments active in additional markets, including Texas, as documented in state regulatory filings [].
Media Coverage
• Dripping Springs, Texas — A project held a ribbon-cutting in June 2025 covered by Hays Free Press []. Basic project details also appear in Texas state regulatory filings [].
• Castle Rock, Colorado — A project at 2278 Manatt Court was named in the Town of Castle Rock’s 2019 Design Awards [].
Recognition
• 2019: Town of Castle Rock Design Award (project at 2278 Manatt Court, Castle Rock, Colorado) [].
References
[1] Hays Free Press — “Dripping Springs opens, cuts ribbon on Personal Warehouse” (June 18, 2025).* [http:///www.haysfreepress.com/article/25345%2Cdripping-springs-opens-cuts-ribbon-on-personal-warehouse]
